```yaml
name: Harness Drift Report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  harness-drift-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run harness drift check
        run: npx ts-node scripts/dev/repo-drift-check.ts
        env:
          CI: true
```
